space.subject: Battery

nodes.label: design a battery
nodes.detail: The problem AARL was given.

nodes.label: Power and Thermal
nodes.detail: how energy is consumed, converted and removed (judged on energy per operation)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: Power density is limited by heat removal, so performance is capped by thermals rather than by the logic itself.

nodes.label: Data Representation
nodes.detail: how information is encoded, stored and transported (judged on information density per unit cost)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: The representation is uniform across the whole tensor or molecule, so a few significant elements pay for many insignificant ones.

nodes.label: Material Stack
nodes.detail: which materials carry the function and why (judged on material performance limit)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: Material choice is constrained by what can be manufactured reliably at scale, not by the best measured property in the laboratory.

nodes.label: Scaling Strategy
nodes.detail: what happens to cost and benefit as the system grows (judged on marginal cost of additional scale)
nodes.basis: keyword overlap with the problem statement + detected-domain affinity + editorial exploration priority (order only)
nodes.assumed_limitation: Benefit saturates before cost does, so adding more of the same resource stops buying proportionate improvement.

nodes.label: Alternative-Substrate Battery Power Management
nodes.detail: Would moving the cost-dominant operation of Battery onto a different physical carrier improve energy per operation once interface overhead is included?

nodes.label: Oscillator-Synchronized Battery Power Management
nodes.detail: Can emergent phase alignment replace an explicit global barrier to improve energy per operation for Battery?

nodes.label: Alternative-Substrate Battery Data Representation
nodes.detail: Would moving the cost-dominant operation of Battery onto a different physical carrier improve information density per unit cost once interface overhead is included?

nodes.label: Bistable Battery Data Representation
nodes.detail: Can a non-volatile physical state improve information density per unit cost for Battery whose data representation state is currently refreshed continuously?

nodes.label: Alternative-Substrate Battery Material Stack
nodes.detail: Would moving the cost-dominant operation of Battery onto a different physical carrier improve material performance limit once interface overhead is included?

nodes.label: Bistable Battery Material Stack
nodes.detail: Can a non-volatile physical state improve material performance limit for Battery whose material stack state is currently refreshed continuously?

nodes.label: Heterogeneity-Aware Battery Scaling Strategy
nodes.detail: Can capability-matched routing improve marginal cost of additional scale for Battery made of deliberately non-uniform participants?

nodes.label: Decentralized Battery Scaling Strategy
nodes.detail: Can decentralized coordination improve marginal cost of additional scale for Battery in situations where a single centralized controller cannot observe the whole system quickly enough?
